brief:
Israeli voters head to polls in one of the country's most consequential elections, with politicians intensifying their final efforts to mobilize support. The race carries significant weight for Israel's political future, according to Al Jazeera English.

The timing of the election reflects deepening divisions within Israeli society over core governance issues. Campaign activity has accelerated as voting day approaches, with parties competing aggressively for voter backing in what analysts consider a pivotal moment for the nation's direction.
dek: Israelis are about to vote in one of the most decisive elections in the country’s history.
title: Israeli politicians mount last-minute campaign push before decisive election
